review: I like the hazard variety and the clean, readable screens. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate look like real routing stages: commit, keep moving, time the beam. But skill barely buys time. Ferry Lines ends at 12.3 s for everyone, so the platforms set my pace, not my hands. Spring Loaded is the same, 11.1 against 11.0. In Spike Garden the high-skill run takes 25.1 s, twice the mid run, which smells like forced waiting. Saw Mill spikes too early at 43% with floating saws that look hard to read in the air. First Steps kills 29 of 100 on its first spike row. Gauntlet is a good mixed final exam.
best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate reward commitment and timing with deaths that look like my own fault.
worst: Ferry Lines is a 12.3 s autoscroller for every skill level, so there is nothing to optimise.
